titulo: A Study of the Bioequivalence of 70-mg Alendronate and 70-mg Alendronate in Combination With 5600 IU Vitamin D (MK0217A-253)

braco.nome: Sequence 4- vitamin D then alendronate+vitamin D combination
braco.texto: Participants in Part 2 received a single dose of 5600 IU vitamin D, administered as two 2800 IU tablets in Period 1 followed by a 70mg alendronate+5600 IU vitamin D combination tablet in Period 2. A washout of at least 12 days separated each treatment period.

Um intervalo de pelo menos 12 dias separou cada período de tratamento.
